title: Verify Result
description: The evidence envelope, scoped to one verify PIPELINE RUN (changed in 0.2.0; was per-tier). One record summarizes all stages run under a profile and carries the overall verdict — this is the unit progress items cite (evidence_ref) and routing records cite (verify_ref). Verdict enum is exactly pass|fail|error; model confidence is deliberately not a member. A record may be a cached replay: an unchanged working tree deterministically yields the same verdict, so replaying it is legitimate evidence — legitimacy that rests entirely on the determinism requirement (flaky stages poison replay validity). Feedback fields are hard-bounded because they are re-injected into model context on retry.

node_id.description: Graph node that requested verification, when under a graph.

target.description: What was verified: a task id, module, or 'working tree'.

verdict.description: pass: every executed stage passed. fail: a stage failed deterministically on the code. error: the pipeline itself broke (tool missing, no result bundle, precondition failure) — an error is a harness/loop bug to fix and never counts as pass.

profile.description: Which declared profile ran. 'full' is reserved and means all tiers. Only a full-profile pass satisfies a progress item's evidence_ref for status=done; a quick pass is real but partial evidence and must never masquerade as full (cache keys include the profile for exactly this reason).

stages.description: Every stage the pipeline executed (or deliberately skipped), in execution order. Fail-fast means the array ends at the first failure.

verdict.description: skipped is legal only for tiers declared skippable (e.g. a targeted-test tier with no mapped targets) and counts as pass for ordering purposes.

flaky_passed.description: Test identifiers that failed, were rerun under the tier's declared flaky_reruns policy, and passed. Disclosure here is mandatory whenever a retry rescued the verdict — a flaky pass is reported, never hidden. Undeclared retries and undisclosed flaky passes are contract violations.

selection.description: Optional. Whether this stage ran its full applicable set or an adapter-selected subset (e.g. changed-file-mapped test classes). cost_class stays a pure cost label; selection carries the role distinction the 'targeted tier' strain finding asked for. Added in 0.4.0.

failed_stage.description: Stage id whose failure produced the fail verdict. Required when verdict=fail.

feedback.description: The failing stage's distilled feedback, designed for model re-injection: bounded, specific, tail-of-traceback not head.

raw_refs.description: State-dir-relative paths to full logs / result bundles for the rare case the summary isn't enough. Paths only — never inline raw log content here.

cache.description: Verdict-cache provenance. Structurally this is the observation-cache pattern applied to verify itself: tool = verify+profile, single synthetic input = the working-tree content hash.

replayed.description: True when this record is a cached verdict served for an unchanged tree rather than a fresh run.

tree_hash.description: Content hash of the working tree this verdict is keyed by (e.g. HEAD + tracked diff + untracked file contents; gitignored noise excluded).

recorded_at.description: When the underlying fresh run happened. For replays, started_at is the replay time and this is the original.

exhausted.description: True when this failure consumed the last budgeted attempt. Exhaustion MUST surface as explicit failure with accumulated evidence — never silence or a softened success claim.

started_at.description: Actual wall-clock start of this verification. Placeholder or fabricated timestamps are a contract violation even though format validation cannot catch them; the routing-log grammar lint enforces plausibility (a cited document's started_at must fall within the citing run's window).

mode.description: Attestation mode. real: a genuine verification of the target. demo/stub: produced by a test or demo seam and MUST self-identify as such — a non-real document never satisfies done-evidence, regardless of verdict or profile. Added in 0.4.0 after a demo stub emitted profile='full' with fabricated timestamps and validated cleanly: evidence must attest to its own completeness and provenance.

profile_tiers.description: Tier ids this profile comprises, self-declared. Lets a consumer check the stages array against the claimed profile without access to the harness declaration, and lets conformance cross-check both against the declaration. Strongly recommended for all documents; a 'full' document whose stages omit a listed tier (other than legal skips) is dishonest. Added in 0.4.0 (the profile-linkage gap, weaponized).
